claims.claim: Delegates from 44 nations created the Bretton Woods international monetary system in July 1944.
The 1971 U.S. policy ended dollar convertibility to gold within the international monetary system.
The Smithsonian Agreement attempted to preserve the Bretton Woods system after the 1971 gold convertibility decision.
The 1965 coinage changes introduced reduced silver content in half dollars and no silver in new dimes and quarters.
